# Website Announcement Bar

Public Odoo module (18.0 / 19.0) adding a site-wide announcement bar above the website header, edited natively in the website builder.

## Language

**Announcement Bar**:
The single site-wide bar element rendered above the website header. There is one per website.
_Avoid_: Notification Bar, Top Bar, Alert Bar

**Message**:
One unit of content inside the Announcement Bar. The bar displays one Message at a time and rotates through them; a bar has one or more Messages.
_Avoid_: Slide, Announcement, Notification

**Dismissal**:
A visitor closing the whole Announcement Bar for the remainder of their browser-tab session. Admin-controlled option; always whole-bar, never per-Message.
_Avoid_: Close-out, opt-out
